answer: Modeling adversarial capital as a hypervelocity comet, the protocol enforces Sybil resistance via accelerating marginal costs driven by compounding opportunity costs and non-refundable attestation fees. Confronted by this cost, a rational adversary finds no profit oasis, as staking collateral and slashing penalties annihilate arbitrage, yielding negative expected attack utility. Finally, zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces marginal costs into the umber depths of infeasibility, locking the network into a robust Nash equilibrium where defection is irrational.
